text:
Jordan (Customer): Hi — partner credits from our AWS Marketplace purchase aren't showing up in our Redwood account. AWS marks the order MP-0X9Y12 as 'accepted by seller' on 2026-02-15 but in Redwood it's still pending. We're blocked on a staging smoke test.
Alex S. (Support): Sorry about that, Jordan. Can you paste the Marketplace Order ID, the account email you used, and the AWS payer account ID? I'll pull entitlement logs.
Jordan (Customer): Order: MP-0X9Y12. Account email: infra-qa@acme.co. AWS payer account: 9876543210. We registered the subscription under the sub-account acme-staging.
Alex S. (Support): Thanks — checking. Quick ask: can you run this (no real token needed, just paste the response):
```
curl -s -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' 'https://console.redwood.com/internal/billing/marketplace?order_id=MP-0X9Y12'
```
Jordan (Customer): Returned JSON (redacted): `{"entitlement_id":"E-ABCD1234","status":"pending","target_entity":"acme-prod","seller_sku":"accel-100"}`. So it looks targeted at acme-prod, not our staging sub-account.
Maria (Billing): FYI — when marketplace entitlements arrive they bind to the legal entity that matches the Marketplace registration (org/merchant mapping). If the entitlement target_entity != your current org id, credits won't surface. Do you know the AWS Organization ID the marketplace buyer used?
Jordan (Customer): AWS console shows payer 9876543210 and organization id o-0aa1b. Our staging subaccount is a sibling subaccount (123123123) under the same payer.
Taylor (Partner): From the partner side I confirmed seller accepted the activation and sent an entitlement for seller_sku accel-100. We can reissue the entitlement to a different target org, but typically Redwood needs an internal rebind action and a partner confirmation. We can do the partner-side reissue if you open the support escalation.
Alex S. (Support): OK opening Partner Ops escalation. @Maria can you flag for legal-entity rebind? @Billing Bot can you kick off the entitlement rebind flow for MP-0X9Y12 to org_123staging?
Billing Bot: ⌛ Entitlement rebind initiated for order MP-0X9Y12. ETA ~2 business days. Ticket RBW-2026-4572 created.
Jordan (Customer): Is there any temp workaround? We need credits to run a smoke test today.
Alex S. (Support): Workaround options: 1) Create a temporary subaccount under the legal entity the entitlement is bound to (acme-prod) and run tests there, or 2) if you can grant me org-admin, I can attempt to manually apply the entitlement to acme-staging while rebind is pending. Steps for option 1: Console -> Admin -> Organizations -> Create subaccount 'acme-temp' -> Billing -> Redeem entitlement MP-0X9Y12.
Jordan (Customer): Tried redeem on our side but the "Apply" button is greyed out — I don't have org-admin perms.
Alex S. (Support): If you invite me (alex.s) as org-admin I can try to apply it. Alternatively add Jordan (Customer) as org-admin so they can do the temporary redeem. Which do you prefer?
Jordan (Customer): I'll invite you as org-admin now.
Alex S. (Support): Received invite, trying apply now...
Billing Bot: ✅ Entitlement rebind completed. Credits posted to acme-staging (E-ABCD1234 -> org_123staging). Ticket RBW-2026-4572 closed.
Jordan (Customer): Confirmed — credits appeared and the smoke tests passed. Thanks everyone :thumbsup: This was a legal-entity binding mismatch between the AWS order and our target sub-account. For future buyers: ensure the Marketplace buyer org matches the target Redwood org or request partner-side reissue before provisioning.
